newsitem.title: USA: News Corp no comment on Dodgers.
newsitem.headline: News Corp no comment on Dodgers.

text.p: News Corp Ltd on Monday declined comment on a published report that its Fox unit was interested in buying the Los Angeles Dodgers professional baseball team.
The Los Angeles Times reported today that the team would be sold within two months, and it quoted National Football League sources as saying News Corp's Fox was interested.
"We're not able to comment on that," a News Corp spokesman said. "It's been rumored for a while."
A spokesman for the Dodgers said the team would have no immediate comment.
The newspaper quoted Peter O'Malley, who owns the team, as saying it would be sold within two months. He did not name any potential buyers.
Officials at the baseball commissioner's office were not available for comment.
